shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rectangular stone surface
profile head with a hooked beak / bird-like head
wing rendered with rows of feathers or striations
horizontal band or register line crossing the field
repeated small motifs filling background space
upright figure with limbs shown in profile
small handled object held at the side
justification: Both are shallow relief on a tall rectangular stone face, each dominated by a profile beaked/winged creature and crossed by a horizontal register line, with smaller repeated motifs filling the surrounding field. The manner is quite different, however: A is crudely pecked, sparse and schematic with figures floating on bare ground, while B is finely modelled, densely detailed and organised around a single large frontal-bodied figure framed by regular rosette borders.
